mutation.name: publicationUpdate
mutation.description:
Updates a [`Publication`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Publication).

You can add or remove [products](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Product) from the publication, with a maximum of 50 items per operation. The [`autoPublish`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/publicationUpdate#arguments-input.fields.autoPublish) field determines whether new products automatically display in this publication.

args.name: id
args.description: The ID of the publication to update.

args.name: input
args.description: The input fields to use when updating the publication.

__type.name: PublicationUpdateInput
__type.description: The input fields for updating a publication.

inputFields.name: publishablesToAdd
inputFields.description: A list of publishable IDs to add. The maximum number of publishables to update simultaneously is 50.

inputFields.name: publishablesToRemove
inputFields.description: A list of publishable IDs to remove. The maximum number of publishables to update simultaneously is 50.

inputFields.name: autoPublish
inputFields.description: Whether new products should be automatically published to the publication.

__type.name: PublicationUserErrorCode
__type.description: Possible error codes that can be returned by `PublicationUserError`.

enumValues.name: UNSUPPORTED_PUBLICATION_ACTION
enumValues.description: Can't perform this action on a publication.

enumValues.name: PUBLICATION_LOCKED
enumValues.description: The publication is currently being modified. Please try again later.

enumValues.name: UNSUPPORTED_PUBLISHABLE_TYPE
enumValues.description: A catalog publication can only contain products.

enumValues.name: CANNOT_MODIFY_APP_CATALOG_PUBLICATION
enumValues.description: Can't modify a publication that belongs to an app catalog.

enumValues.name: CANNOT_MODIFY_MARKET_CATALOG_PUBLICATION
enumValues.description: Can't modify a publication that belongs to a market catalog.

enumValues.name: CANNOT_MODIFY_APP_CATALOG
enumValues.description: Cannot modify a catalog for an app.

enumValues.name: CANNOT_MODIFY_MARKET_CATALOG
enumValues.description: Cannot modify a catalog for a market.

enumValues.name: TAKEN
enumValues.description: The input value is already taken.

enumValues.name: TOO_LONG
enumValues.description: The input value is too long.

enumValues.name: TOO_SHORT
enumValues.description: The input value is too short.

enumValues.name: PRODUCT_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_CATALOG_TYPE
enumValues.description: A product publication cannot be created because the catalog type associated with this publication does not permit publications of this product type.

enumValues.name: PUBLICATION_UPDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
enumValues.description: The limit for simultaneous publication updates has been exceeded.
